scope_note: Candidates represent complementary product classes: specialist newsroom/newswire, publisher platforms, newsletter operations, video/media portals, podcast publishing, and lightweight writing. Scores support screening within use cases and must not be treated as a single universal ranking. No candidate has verified end-to-end Arabic/RTL readiness.

scoring_rubric.interpretation: Provisional comparative screening; not adoption approval, security assessment, legal opinion, or guarantee that features work in all current versions. Unlike product categories are not interchangeable.

records.name: Superdesk

records.license_notes: Review source-offer/copy-left obligations for modified or hosted use; separately review companion repositories, dependencies, Publisher and commercial services.

records.arabic_rtl: Not verified for newsroom client, editor, themes or output channels.
